$description: mob-design TIER 3 — component tokens. Hand-maintained mirror of the component block in css/tokens.css, which is the source of truth. This is where the calibrated, off-scale values live: a card's 15px/16px padding is not a failure of the spacing scale, it is a measured value from a real dense surface. Parking it here keeps the public scale clean AND keeps repetition exact — every card in the product reads one token, so two cards can never drift 1px apart. Values written as an alias ({group.name}) are var() in the CSS; values written literally are literal in the CSS.

control.$description: Height, horizontal padding and radius move together per size step. Heights are the target contract — do not set an ad-hoc height on a button, change its size step. Control geometry is the one thing a density zone never touches: an M button is the same button on a marketing page and in a data grid.

h-md.$description: Default. Matches the column header baseline, so a control in a header row aligns to the grid without a nudge.

gap.$description: Icon-to-label inside a control, and control-to-control in an action stack.

icon-xl.$description: Standalone icon size, not paired with a label.

tap-target.$description: Shared coarse-pointer floor: buttons and tabs use a pseudo-element hit area; menu rows and interactive chips grow their real box to preserve their state pseudo-elements.

card.$description: The default container. Padding is asymmetric on purpose (15 vertical / 16 horizontal): at this density, equal padding reads top-heavy once a label sits above a figure. pad-y and pad-x are the two tokens a density zone DOES move.

gap.$description: Gap between stacked cards in a rail.

chip.$description: A chip sits ON a card, so its surface is one step up (surface-raised) and its text is one step brighter (text.muted-hi) than the same metadata would be on the card itself.

field.$description: Derived in full — the source surface has no inputs. The rule it follows: a field is SUNKEN at rest and rises to surface on hover, the inverse of a button. That inversion is what tells a reader which controls accept typing.

h.$description: Fields are L even where buttons beside them are M — a typing target is not a click target.

avatar.$description: Entity marks: a letter or icon glyph on a tinted circle, coloured from color.series-tint / color.series-glyph. Never a drop shadow; overlapping marks separate with a border painted in the parent's background.

overlap.$description: Negative margin on the second mark of a pair. Roughly a third of the lg diameter: enough overlap to read as one unit, little enough that both glyphs stay legible.

data.$description: Geometry for the marks that carry the numbers: composition bars, discrete meters, sparklines. All measured. These are small on purpose — a data mark supports the figure beside it and must never outweigh it.

bar-gap.$description: Gap between segments. The gap is what makes a stacked bar readable at 5px; without it the hues merge.

meter-h.$description: Full height of a discrete meter row — also the height of its ACTIVE bin.

meter-bin-h.$description: Inactive bin. The 15/22 ratio is the whole encoding: the active bin is taller, brighter and glowing; the rest recede.

spark-h.$description: Sparkline area height. No axes, no labels — a sparkline shows shape, the figure above it shows the value.

spark-stroke.$description: Draw with non-scaling stroke so the line keeps this weight at any width.

spark-fill-from.$description: Top stop of the vertical fill gradient under the line, in the line's own colour.

spark-fill-to.$description: Bottom stop. Near zero, not zero — the fill fades into the surface instead of stopping on an edge.

overlay.$description: Derived. Widths are capped rather than fluid so an overlay never becomes a second page; a flow that needs more room than the modal width is a route, not a modal.

tooltip-max-w.$description: A tooltip that needs more than this is documentation — use a popover.

rhythm.$description: The three tokens a density zone moves. Declare the zone on a container — data-mob-density="marketing" | "product" | "data" — and every descendant inherits the temperament without a single screen-level override. Colour, radius and control geometry never move with the zone.

section-gap.$description: Between major sections of a page.

stack-gap.$description: Between siblings in a vertical stack.
